mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM supplier WHERE supplier_code = #{supplierCode} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM supplier WHERE deleted = 0 AND supplier_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{supplierCode}, '%') AND supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{supplierName}, '%') AND status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier (supplier_code, supplier_name, contact, phone, address, status, remark, create_time, deleted) VALUES (#{supplierCode}, #{supplierName}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier SET supplier_code = #{supplierCode}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, contact = #{contact}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE supplier SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
